verdict.rationale: Running a desktop OS on single-board computers is a fair question for a Linux distribution, so the axis applies. The pack never mentions SBC support. The aarch64 artifact is a WSL image, not an SBC image, and the low-cost hardware reports concern laptops and generic low-end machines, not single-board computers.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get a full desktop developer experience running on low-cost single-board computers
